summary: Singularity Future Technology Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 340,000 common shares at $3.00 per share and 260,000 pre-funded warrants at $2.999 each, for gross proceeds up to $1.8 million. The offering is an ordinary capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. Univest Securities acts as placement agent with a 7% cash fee. Securities are listed on NASDAQ under SGLY. Delivery is expected on or about August 19, 2026. The filing is routine in nature, with no strategic transaction, tender offer, or restructuring involved.
